timings.note: Timings are per the current schedule; a specific stylist's exact slot is confirmed by the front desk, not guaranteed here.

appointment_policy: Appointments are preferred, especially for color/keratin services and bridal makeup; walk-ins are accepted for quick services (haircut, threading) subject to same-day availability. A requested slot is NOT confirmed until the front desk calls back to confirm — never tell a caller their exact time is booked.
patch_test_note: For any FIRST-TIME hair color, keratin, or henna service, a patch test 48 hours before the appointment is recommended to check for allergic reaction — the agent should mention this once when a first-time chemical service is discussed, not as a blanket disclaimer on every call.
results_disclaimer: Hair color results, keratin/smoothening outcomes, and skin treatment results vary by individual hair/skin type and cannot be guaranteed exactly as shown in photos or references — the stylist discusses realistic expectations in person.
bridal_note: Bridal makeup bookings require an in-person consultation and trial session first — a phone booking alone does not confirm a bridal date. Route bridal enquiries to a consultation appointment, not a direct booking.
membership_note: A loyalty/membership card offering discounts on repeat visits exists, but the agent should not quote a specific discount percentage unless it's in the data — route exact membership benefits to the front desk.
media_caveat: Salon photos and stylist portfolio images online are illustrative of past work, not a guarantee of an identical result for every client.
legal_caveat: This salon does not provide medical or dermatological advice over the phone. Any skin/scalp condition, allergy history, or medical concern should be discussed with the stylist in person before a chemical service. Prices and availability are indicative and confirmed by the front desk.
